answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 150717 Country: UAE Title: Zakat on Under construction Flat whose Installment is being paid and property is still not registered under my name. Question: I have purchased a flat from a builder with repayment as per construction plan without interest. Since I have been paying regular EMI as per the construction every 3-4 months as the payment is due, the property will only be registered under my name once the construction is completed and full payment is done (may be by 2018). Please advise how the zakah is calculated and payable for such investment. Answer ID: 150717 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 691/615/D=9/1438) According to Shariah, it is called istisna (to get something prepared on order) to buy some flat or other products with the specification of features and with the condition of delivering it in some future date. Under istisna contract whatsoever advance amount the buyer pays in advance or in installments its sole owner is the seller (builder) and its zakah is wajib on him. Hence in the question mentioned above, if you at the time of booking the flat kept in mind the said conditions (specification of features and the condition of delivering it in future) then it shall be called istisna contract and the amount which you have paid its zakah shall not be wajib on you rather it shall be wajib on the seller (builder). قال الشيخ تقي العثماني الاستصناع : ان يطلب المشتري من البائع ان ياتي له بشئ مصنوع بمواد من عنده موصوف فى الذمة ويلتزم البائع بذلك لقاء ثمن متفق عليه. (فقه البيوع ج 1، ص 585) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
